evidence.evidence_text: In this paper, we introduce N-CORE, a novel backbone-agnostic framework designed to disentangle intertwined features like emotion and speaker information from nonverbal vocalizations by leveraging N views of audio samples to learn invariance to specific transformations.
N-CORE achieves competitive performance compared to state-of-the-art methods for emotion and speaker classification on the VIVAE, ReCANVo, and ReCANVo-Balanced datasets.
